# Spectral Eclipse Frontier (v1.1.0)

> Complete Lean 4.35.0 machine-checked resolution of Conjecture 4.1 (`arXiv:2507.18767v1`) and ten-theorem theory of Early State Exclusion (ESE) in 1D quantum spin chains with Perfect State Transfer (PST), cross-verified across 8 polyglot/quantum engines and a pre-registered 4-arm QRNG disorder study.

- Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
- Licenses: Apache-2.0 (code/Lean) · CC-BY-4.0 (manuscript/figures/docs)
- Master Archive ID: `0TH-2026-024` (`https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive`)
- Software Heritage SWHID (`v1.0.0` baseline): `swh:1:snp:37fd5b55ad30a2e1cedc2949415bfacf4d5d1efc`
- Status: Unrefereed research preprint (v1.1.0); AI-assisted under human direction; 0 / 2,000 Mega-Atlas grand problems claimed.

## Key Files
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, Quickstart, Usage, verbatim `#print axioms` (572 theorems, 0 disallowed).
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims C1–C12 tagged `[LEAN-6K]`, `[EXACT-COMP]`, `[EMPIRICAL]` + falsification protocol.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Verification boundaries, honest H4 null result, Real vs. Metaphor, COI & export-control screen.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): End-to-end clean-room replication guide.
- [PREREGISTRATION.md](PREREGISTRATION.md): Pre-registered QRNG study protocol (locked in root commit `1dac632`).
- [DEVIATIONS.md](DEVIATIONS.md): Append-only post-registration deviations log (Deviation #1 optimizer fix).
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Post-release corrections and withdrawal/retraction policy.
- [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml): Palomar-compatible metadata & AI disclosure.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Isolated Mathlib-only specification of all 12 headline comparator targets (290 lines).
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Sorry-free bridge verified across 6 independent checkers via `lake comparator --paranoid`.
- [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean): 52 explicit `#print axioms` + exhaustive `Lean.collectAxioms` audit (572 theorems).
- [dist/Donahue_2026_spectral_eclipse_frontier.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_spectral_eclipse_frontier.pdf): Frozen AMS-LaTeX preprint PDF.
- [dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz](dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz): Byte-reproducible standalone arXiv source bundle.
- [results/polyglot_parity.json](results/polyglot_parity.json): 8-engine parity report (0 mismatches).
- [results/qgtl_qrng_analysis.json](results/qgtl_qrng_analysis.json): Pre-registered Holm-Bonferroni study results (H1–H3 SIG, H4 null).
- [docs/literature-search.md](docs/literature-search.md): Dated literature & prior-art search log.
- [HARDENING_INDEX.md](HARDENING_INDEX.md): Complete file-by-file, folder-by-folder audit index & table of contents.
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): All 3 adversarial hardening cycles (`v1.0.0` + `v1.1.0`) classified across all 10 Build Standard R7 classes.
